dt_note: dt_gauge is SBTS's internal DT: h is measured in units of sqrt(DT), and build_training_tensor always rescales to std(X) = sqrt(DT), so DT cancels and is a pure gauge. dt_physical is the real bar spacing and is what metrics/ must be passed via --dt. They are NOT interchangeable.
note: SBTS is non-parametric: no weights, no loss. These four numbers plus the training array ARE the model.
